The primary measure is closed-won revenue sourced through partners, supported by partner-influenced revenue and the retention and expansion of partner-sourced customers. Relationships, programs, and pipelines are critical in producing signed deals. You will be the executive face of Salesloft to our most strategic partners and the owner of the plan, the team, and the results.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

Private Equity Partnerships

  • Build relationships with private equity firms and their operating partners to position Salesloft as the revenue platform for their portfolio companies.
  • Structure portfolio-wide agreements and programs that turn a firm-level relationship into sourced, closed-won deals across multiple portfolio companies.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to run portfolio-specific plays, from the initial introduction through close.

Cloud Marketplace and Strategic Platform Alliances

  • Build strategic alliances with the CRM and productivity platforms our customers run on, such as Salesforce, Microsoft, and HubSpot, including their app and agent marketplaces.
  • Turn platform relationships into sourced and co-sold pipeline by aligning with these partners' field sellers, not only their partner teams.

ISV and MCP Partnerships

  • Identify, recruit, and sign independent software vendors and AI platforms that integrate with, embed, or distribute Salesloft, including through MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations and agent ecosystems.
  • Define co-sell and co-marketing motions with ISV partners so that integrations produce sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue, not only technical listings.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to shape the partner integration roadmap and make sure partners can build, launch, and sell with confidence.

VAR, BPO, and Services Partnerships

  • Recruit and onboard value-added resellers and business process outsourcing providers that resell, bundle, or deliver Salesloft as part of their sales services.
  • Recruit systems integrators and RevOps consultancies that influence enterprise buying decisions and deliver implementations, and build a services partner motion that speeds time to value and improves retention.

  • Lead from the Front: Youâll be the executive face of Salesloft to strategic partners and set the quotas, coverage models, and standards your team is held to.
  • Make Your Mark: Youâll shape how Salesloft shows up in private equity, cloud marketplaces, ISV and MCP ecosystems, and services channels, not just run the playbook.

WHAT WEâRE LOOKING FOR
Youâre a senior partner and alliances leader who has sourced and closed partner-driven revenue in B2B SaaS and led teams to quota. You build the relationships and programs that turn into signed deals, and you are credible with C-level partners and technical teams alike.   • A track record of sourcing and closing partner-driven revenue and meeting or exceeding quota, with results you can describe in terms of closed-won revenue
  • Experience building or working with private equity relationships, ISV or technology integration partnerships, cloud marketplace and co-sell programs with AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, or VAR, BPO, and services channel programs. Experience in more than one of these is strongly preferred
  • Experience building a partner program from the ground up, or rebuilding one after a merger or acquisition
  • An established network of private equity operating partners and portfolio company leaders
  • Familiarity with AI, API, and MCP-based integration ecosystems, and the ability to talk credibly with technical partners about how Salesloft fits
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex partner, reseller, and revenue-sharing agreements
  • Ability to coach and lead a team, including setting quotas and holding people accountable to them
  • Strong sales acumen and fluency with CRM and partner tools such as Salesforce, partner relationship management platforms, and account-mapping tools, including building partner attribution models. SaaS experience is required
  • Executive presence, including comfort presenting at conferences, events, and webinars and influencing C-suite stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams

THE TEAM

jobs.title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx.

I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies.

Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work.

We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly.

It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business.

Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the People team

Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it.

Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure.

You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room..

What you'll be doing

  • Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side.

  • Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are.

  • Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves.

  • Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort.

  • Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person.

  • Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project.

  • Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you.

  • Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for.

  • Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend.

  • Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role.

  • Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information.

  • Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues.

How we build in an AI-forward company

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world.

Compensation

This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and games nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off and learn more about your background.

  2. Manager interview with our People Lead to explore your experience in more depth.

  3. Skills assessment, presenting a People Analytics deliverable to the team.

  4. Values interview to get to know how you work and how that aligns with hx's culture with our VP of People and Senior Director of Finance and Operations.

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.
